OPENS Ch 10: POST-MORTEM CRIES-FOR-VINDICATION (vv. 1-5) — the martyrs in heaven cry-out for divine-vengeance-and-vindication. Direct parallel to REVELATION 6:9-11 ('I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held: and they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?'). Additional parallels: PSALM 13:1-2 + 89:46 (HOW-LONG laments); LUKE 18:1-8 (the persistent-widow parable as cry-for-vindication); GENESIS 4:10 (Abel's blood crying-from-the-ground); HEBREWS 12:24 ('the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel'). The verse functions as the BRIDGE between completed-martyrdom (Ch 9) and the impending divine-vengeance-on-Ṣiruṣaydan (Ch 12). Tewahedo eschatology preserves the martyrs-cry-for-vindication motif as integral to the doctrine of just-judgment — souls-in-heaven actively-participate in petitioning for the final-judgment.

JOSHUA-LIKE REMEMBRANCE-OF-THE-MARTYRS — memorial-stones-and-covenant-renewal pattern (vv. 14-18). Maqabis-of-Moab institutes a memorial-rite for his five-martyred-sons in the manner of JOSHUA 4:1-9 (the twelve-stones-at-Gilgal memorial of the Jordan-crossing) + JOSHUA 24:25-28 (the great-stone-at-Shechem memorial of the covenant-renewal) + 1 SAMUEL 7:12 (Samuel's Ebenezer stone — 'hitherto hath the LORD helped us'). The REMEMBRANCE-OF-THE-DEAD via material-marker is the canonical-biblical pattern that Meqabyan integrates with the martyr-cult-memorial that the Tewahedo Sǝnkǝsar (Synaxarium) preserves saint-by-saint. Meqabyan's distinctive feature: the GENTILE-CONVERTED-KING institutes the memorial-rite, again inverting the standard-Israelite-leader-establishes-memorial pattern. Maqabis-of-Moab's fatherly-act mirrors the standard Israelite-patriarchal memorial-establishment, completing his integration into the deliverer-judge typology of 4:1.
